Y'know, I wonder what Teddie K. would think if he found out that this
whole idea comes straight from the SPK (Socialist Patients' Collective, a
wing of the Red Army Faction ("Baader-Meinhof", for the uninitiated)).

The basic gist was, that psychiatric illness isn't actually the fault of
the individual -- it is actually caused by capitalist society.

Wonder why the SPK hasn't come out in support of Teddie K.? Oh, yeah....
mighta been because they all got killed by the Israelis.

Bummer.
